DUREP_DATA_PATH.description: Directory where durep stores its data and reports

FILESYSTEMS.description: List of filesystems (mount points or paths) to monitor

DEBUG.description: Enable verbose output (set to 'on' for debug)

SIZE_CUTOFF.description: Minimum file size in bytes to include in reports

DUREP_MAXAGE.description: Maximum age in days for report files to keep (older files are pruned)
